fields.name: source_selected_date
fields.description: Original date reported by the archived default-schedule source; independent of calendar selection.

fields.name: selection_basis
fields.description: source or calendar. Calendar means tomorrow was inside the show date range at the daily 19:00 America/New_York decision.

fields.name: selection_at
fields.description: When the current selected_date was established; retained on unchanged selection.

fields.name: authority_checked_at
fields.description: Last successful scheduled validation of canonical identity, archived source and calendar selection. Not a source fetch timestamp; last_checked remains original source time.
